::: {.notes}
Huang et al. use Qwen3.8-27B to answer prompt-specific yes/no questions about the generated clips. Table 6 groups these judgments by dimension. It reports a fraction from zero to one for each kind of question. These checks measure what happens in the scene independently of how accurately its requested words are spelled. [VTR-Bench · Table 6](https://arxiv.org/html/2610.01499v1#A3.T6).

Frames at 3, 15 and 29 seconds were extracted from the singer video beneath the 30-second long-form storytelling section of ByteDance’s launch report. The published prompt describes the accompanying camera moves. This is one vendor-selected example of a single generation.

The specification table follows the 19 October 2026 workbook. The card uses the first-party consumer launch date, 31 July. The API's approximately 7 August availability date is supported by secondary reporting in the workbook.

Seed describes the 2.5 model as building on Seedance 2.0's joint multimodal audio-video architecture. That is a documented lineage statement, not permission to copy 2.0 parameter counts, training recipes or other undisclosed details into this card. No corpus sizes, sources, licences, objective, compute or post-training method are given. Output-language support is not a training-data inventory.

The first-party claim is up to 30 seconds in one generation, with joint audio and video. The source accounts of resolution differ: Dreamina markets clean 4K, BytePlus lists 480p/720p/1080p, and secondary ModelArk/API listings narrow this to 480p/720p. The card therefore preserves the partial inference status. It does not collapse these into a universal native-4K claim or display one universal price.

The 50-reference budget is 30 images, 10 videos and 10 audio files. Timestamp-based edits and multi-round extension are documented. Dreamina's 180-second Long Video Mode is a platform workflow, not one 180-second generation. The precise first/last-frame I2V and Draft Complete controls in the workbook are secondary-source claims; the official ModelArk documentation was not read in that audit. Complex motion and interactions among multiple objects remain limitations acknowledged by Seed. Public weights were not found.

**Sheet-row provenance:** scope/architecture 6–8; data 12–13; training 17–18; release/inference 22–29 and limitations 31; tools/access 35–41. **Status provenance:** `Сводка`, row 10, columns B–F.
